title: A Swordfish Stabbed a Submarine 2,000 Feet Underwater

scenes.text: A swordfish once stabbed a submarine 2,000 feet underwater.
It was 1967, and the research sub Alvin was sitting on the seafloor off Florida.
A swordfish about eight feet long rammed it, and its sword jammed into the sub's body.
The crew aborted the dive and rose to the surface with the fish still stuck.
Back on the ship, the swordfish was cooked for dinner.
So yes, a fish attacked a submarine, and the submarine crew ate it.

description:
A swordfish once stabbed the research submarine Alvin 2,000 feet underwater.
On July 6, 1967 it rammed the sub, and its sword jammed into the body. The crew aborted the dive and the fish ended up as dinner.
Would you have eaten it?
first_comment: A swordfish rammed a sub, and the crew ate it. Who won that fight?
